ReportItem.pluginName: MS17-010: EternalBlue SMB Remote Code Execution
ReportItem.description: The remote Windows host is affected by a remote code execution vulnerability in SMBv1 (EternalBlue).
An unauthenticated attacker can establish a vulnerable Netlogon secure channel connection and reset the domain controller's password.
The RDP service is affected by a remote code execution vulnerability (BlueKeep) reachable pre-authentication.

ReportItem.pluginName: Apache Struts2 Jakarta Multipart Parser RCE
ReportItem.description: The Jakarta Multipart parser in Apache Struts2 is vulnerable to OGNL injection leading to remote code execution.
The remote host is affected by an out-of-bounds read in the TLS heartbeat extension (Heartbleed).
The SSL certificate for this service is signed by an unknown certificate authority.
